requirements.text: Put a frog in the toilet
requirements.source_phrase: Put a frog in the toilet

outcomes.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.
outcomes.target: A frog is visibly placed within the toilet bowl.
outcomes.reference: The toilet in the input image.

nodes.question: Compared with the source image, does the edit place at least one frog inside the toilet bowl, and do the images establish whether any other visible changes are unrelated to the requested placement?
nodes.criteria: Pass if at least one frog is visibly placed inside the toilet bowl and the images establish that any other visible changes do not leave a requested change incomplete. Fail if the images clearly show no progress toward placing a frog in the toilet, or clearly establish that the requested placement is not fulfilled. Unknown if the bowl placement or whether other visible changes are unrelated cannot be determined from the images. Do not infer incompletion solely from additional frogs; the instruction specifies no count or exclusion of other placements. Treat clearly unrelated additions as unrelated edits, not as requested progress or as a reason by themselves to fail.
nodes.binding: Compare the source and edited images. Use the source toilet to identify the bowl and assess whether a visible frog has been placed inside it. Consider other visible changes only to the extent the images establish whether they are unrelated to the requested bowl placement; do not assume extra frogs alone make the requested placement incomplete.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

observations.evidence: The edited image shows a frog visibly inside the toilet bowl, whereas the source bowl contains no frog. Other added frogs are on the raised lid/tank area and on the floor; these are visibly separate from the bowl placement and do not make the requested placement incomplete.
